resources.string: Rumors
📜 Rumors
%1$d of %2$d rumors heard
Keep filling your Pokédex to hear this rumor (%1$d entries).
Hikers swear a great electric bird rides the thunderstorms, but it only shows itself to trainers with some experience.
In the depths of winter, a bird of ice visits phones that have been left resting for a while.
On long summer days, a bird of fire visits phones that have been left resting for a while.
A scientist\'s notes speak of a creature that only respects trainers who have raised six Pokémon to level 70.
Thunder answers thunder: a beast with a stormy roar appears when lightning fills the sky.
A volcanic beast roams under clear daytime skies, near phones left untouched for an hour or more.
A beast with a crystal-clear mane runs with the rain. Look for it on wet days.
Sailors tell of a guardian of the seas that rises on rainy nights, after long hours of silence.
Once the three legendary beasts are together, a rainbow-colored bird lights up clear days.
An ancient golem of stone stirs on clear days, but only after a long time of stillness.
An ancient golem of ice wakes up when it snows. Some say long winter nights are enough.
An ancient golem of steel walks under grey, cloudy skies after a long time of stillness.
A red dragon appears by day to trainers who have trained the same partner for five days in a row.
A blue dragon appears by night to trainers who have trained the same partner for five days in a row.
A forest spirit travels through time in spring. Very rarely, it has been seen in other seasons too.
Wish upon a star: on clear nights, a sleeping Pokémon may wake up to grant your wish.
The being of knowledge only appears to trainers who have raised three Pokémon to level 50.
The being of emotion dances under the full moon.
The being of willpower tests your resolve: train the same partner for seven days in a row.
Once the three lake guardians are found, the master of time appears by day after two hours of stillness.
Once the three lake guardians are found, the master of space appears by night after two hours of stillness.
A mythical Pokémon is said to appear to trainers whose Pokédex has reached 300 entries.
When the rain won\'t stop and the phone has rested for a long while, the ruler of the seas awakens.
Under a scorching clear sky, after a long rest, the ruler of the land awakens.
When the rulers of sea and land have both been found, the sky dragon descends to calm them.
With the three golems of stone, ice and steel at your side, their colossal master begins to move.
Something lives in the heat of summer volcanoes. On clear days, the ground trembles.
A meteor fell on a clear night. Something came with it from outer space.
On full-moon nights, a lunar Pokémon brings sweet dreams.
Once the lunar Pokémon is with you, beware of nightmares while you sleep.
The prince of the sea only bites the line of a Super Rod.
After meeting the prince of the sea, its smaller kin may follow the Super Rod again and again.
Flowers bloom in spring, and on clear days a tiny hedgehog rides the breeze.
When time and space have both been found, a shadow from another world appears on Halloween night.
The Pokémon of victory appears to trainers who raise a Pokémon all the way to level 100.
A steel sword wanders under cloudy skies.
A rock sword charges under clear skies.
A grass sword dances in the rain.
Once the three swords stand together, a young colt follows them through the rain.
A genie of whirlwinds flies over cloudy skies after a couple of hours of stillness.
A genie of lightning rides the thunderstorms.
When both genies have been found, the guardian of the land brings a bountiful harvest.
Legend says the creator of everything only shows itself to those who have seen nearly every Pokémon.
The white dragon of truth tests strong trainers by day: raise three Pokémon to level 70.
The black dragon of ideals tests strong trainers by night: raise three Pokémon to level 70.
When truth and ideals have both been found, a frozen dragon appears in the snow, or in the depths of winter.
A melody drifts on full-moon nights, but only veteran trainers can hear it.
An ancient insect, rebuilt by humans, appears to trainers with a truly massive Pokédex.
